summary: Final security review passed with no blocking findings. All revised-C trust boundaries and all prior A findings are evidenced in the final sources and passed verification.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: The harness is physically separate from packages/worker-harness and never loads craft-pool.
evidence: Production scripts contain no worker-harness or craft-pool imports.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Its decomposer emits only id, intent, change_spec, acceptance_criteria, and depends_on for each node.
evidence: src/domains/work-intake/decomposition-harness.ts strictly projects and validates exactly the five fields.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Kimi K3 is the bootstrap decomposition model with only approved fail-closed fallback policy.
evidence: settings.json has no static defaultModel or fallbackModels.
pi-model-invoker.mjs passes the exact selected provider-qualified model as a separate --model argv value; K3 and Sol argv tests passed.
Sol-only availability is accepted and routing records fallback index 0; unavailable explicit K3 and no-candidate cases fail closed.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: The invocation records prompt, model, tool, package, and code-graph revision provenance.
evidence: Pi identity is digest-checked before --version or --list-models execution and supplied to runDecomposition provenance.
Work-intake provenance tests confirm immutable selected-model, sanitized prompt, package, breadth, revision, and actual Pi path/version/digest evidence.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Schema-invalid output is rejected or repaired only within an explicit bounded policy; the model cannot validate, persist, approve, or dispatch its own DAG.
evidence: Strict output shape, limits, one repair maximum, invocation deadline, and immutable records remain in decomposition-harness.ts.
Read-only agent and package-separation regressions passed.

risks: A narrow OS-level TOCTOU interval remains after final executable verification and before spawn; verification occurs immediately before each initial and repair spawn.
Uncatchable process termination can prevent in-process whole-subtree cleanup.
Pi --model selector behavior remains an external pinned-runtime contract; exact K3/Sol argv and removal of static overrides are covered.
Deterministic sanitization may miss novel secret encodings, and provider cancellation can lag the local timeout.

trust_boundaries_reviewed: Inherited environment: launch.mjs rejects mock/test, caller-root, and skip controls; child environments are allowlisted and use fixed PATH.
Test-only dependencies: production scripts contain no test-helper imports or mock-selection controls; tests use local fake executables and direct in-process ports.
Untrusted target workspace: runtime-parent.mjs creates private HOME/XDG beneath a fresh canonical /tmp child, independent of workspace and inherited temporary roots.

Sensitive prompt artifacts: pi-model-invoker.mjs confines prompt directories/files to the private runtime parent, rejects symlink swaps, uses restrictive modes and O_NOFOLLOW, and removes temporary prompt subtrees.
Pi registry availability: preflight parses registry output and requires an approved candidate; deterministic routing admits only K3 or the configured Sol fallback and fails closed otherwise.
Routing-to-adapter model binding: pi-model-invoker.mjs uses separate --model and selected-model argv entries; settings.json has no static model or fallback override; K3 and Sol argv tests pass.

Trusted process execution: all Pi version, registry, initial, and repair calls use process.execPath with absolute Pi paths and fixed /usr/bin:/bin PATH; identity digest is checked before Pi execution and rechecked before every model spawn.

Prompt/provider response boundary: sanitization, prompt/response limits, bounded public errors, invocation-wide timeout, abort handling, and one schema-only repair remain enforced without shell interpolation.
Provenance: runDecomposition receives verified Pi path/version/digest and deterministically constructs deeply frozen sanitized records; selectedModel equals routing evidence and invocation argv.

Actor/package authority separation: architecture tests confirm orchestrator-harness remains separate from worker-harness and craft-pool; spec-decomposer remains read-only with no persistence, approval, queue, Gate 1, or dispatch authority.
security_commands: Reviewed persisted C, revised C, R, A, F, passed plan-security, attempt-1 T, final source, focused security tests, and final verification artifacts.
Reviewed production mock-control and static-model source scans.
Reviewed final package, work-intake, root, typecheck, and worker passed outputs.
residual_risk: Final verify-to-spawn TOCTOU is minimized but cannot be eliminated solely with pathname verification.
Uncatchable termination can leave private runtime artifacts until external cleanup.
Sanitizer coverage and provider cancellation behavior remain bounded residual risks.
